# GroundUp

> GroundUp is an online education platform and community for affordable housing
> development, built by Dr. Gina Merritt of Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures —
> 30+ years and a $390M+ portfolio, $6B+ underwritten, from public housing in the Bronx to
> developer and owner. It exists for underrepresented and emerging developers:
> the knowledge, the community, and the resources to get deals done and build
> generational wealth from the ground up.

## What GroundUp teaches
- Predevelopment: reading markets, valuing land, controlling a site
- Building your team: JV partnerships, ownership vs. economic interest
- Financing the deal: capital stacks, LIHTC & tax credits, closing the gap
- Why affordable housing doesn't pencil — and how deals close anyway
- Zoning, entitlements & what you're allowed to build
- Design & construction management
- After opening day: operations, lease-up, and the long game
- New expertise added every quarter

## Pricing — the full fee structure
All prices in USD. Memberships bill monthly (or annually at roughly 10% off). No coupon codes exist; every discount is applied automatically by the account.

### Memberships
- Free ($0): browse every course outline (lesson content locked), one free live Lunch & Learn, a community profile. Can buy passes and sessions.
- Member ($49.99/mo · $599.88/yr): every course and lesson, case studies, worksheets, read access to the community, resource lists
- Builder ($149.99/mo · $1,799.88/yr): + post and network in the community, the Lunch & Learn recording library, view-only templates and guides. Most popular.
- Premium ($249.99/mo · $2,999.88/yr): + 3 template downloads/month, the Opportunity Board (RFPs and funding windows), the JV & Partnerships channel, group office hours with Dr. Merritt (3/yr), 10% off 1:1 sessions, 1 included 1:1 session per year (after 4 months, no rollover). Best value.
- Owner ($499.99/mo · $5,999.88/yr, limited seats): + direct messages to Dr. Merritt and team, 3 included 1:1 advisory sessions per year (after 4 months, no rollover), group office hours (6/yr), unlimited downloads including the Developer's Playbook, 30% off 1:1 sessions, the private Owner Lounge, NREUV partner-network referral codes

### Founding members (insider waitlist, first year only)
- 25% off any membership tier for the entire first year: Member $37.49, Builder $112.49, Premium $187.49, Owner $374.99 per month
- First year of live Lunch & Learns free, a permanent founding badge, 15% off the first three retainer months
- Applied automatically at signup — no codes

### Course passes (one-time)
- Single Course Pass $100 (one course, 60 days)
- All-Access Pass $275 (every course, 30 days)
- Lifetime Pass $5,000 (every course forever, one year of Builder free, group office hours for 5 years, every Lunch & Learn for life; numbered, limited run)

### Lunch & Learn
- One live session $39.99 · one-year pass $105 · Lifetime Pass $350. Free members get one live session free.

### 1:1 sessions with Dr. Merritt (45 minutes, specialized)
- Deal Review $500 · Strategy Session $425 · Capital Stack Review $550 · Community Development $375
- Premium members 10% off, Owner members 30% off (rounded down to the nearest $5)

### Senior Advisor retainers (Dr. Merritt embedded on your project, month to month)
- Advisor 5: $3,025/mo (5 hrs) · Advisor 10: $5,500/mo (10 hrs) · Advisor 15: $7,700/mo (15 hrs). All include everything in Owner.
- Path in: free discovery call → optional $1,500 Full Project Intake (credited against the first retainer month) → retainer
- Intake refunds are discretionary; if a session happened with no real deal on the table, any refund is reduced by $550

### Referral program
- Members and partners get custom referral links. People who join through one get $5 / $15 / $20 / $25 off per month (by tier) for 24 months. Referrers earn 25% off at 15 referrals, 50% at 25, a comped membership at 50.

### Organizations (Partner)
- Agencies, CDFIs, and nonprofit developer programs sponsor a cohort's first year at a negotiated group rate with a branded partner page, a private cohort channel, and cohort-only office hours. No fixed price — see /partner-interest.

## About the founder
Dr. Gina Merritt — Bronx-raised, from public housing to $390M+ portfolio in real estate
development. Founder of Northern Real Estate Urban Ventures (Washington, DC).
Notable projects include 9410 Hough (Cleveland), Nannie Helen (Washington DC),
Parkway House, and Beacon Center DC.

## Who GroundUp is for
Everyone who needs development knowledge: working developers, house flippers
scaling into ground-up development, small multifamily owners (2-6 units) going
bigger, people with a family property or a site opportunity who don't know
where to start, developers heading into their first big deal, nonprofits,
CDFIs, banks and institutions, and community members entering the industry.
The core member: someone with the skill and intelligence for development who
needs help with one or more parts of the process — the financing, the JVs,
the funding, the underwriting — and wants it from someone who has closed
billions in real deals.

People searching for: real estate development education, how to become a real
estate developer, affordable housing development courses, LIHTC training,
tax credit financing explained, capital stack education, first-time developer
resources, how to scale from flipping houses to development, small multifamily
to large multifamily, what to do with inherited family property, BIPOC and
underrepresented developer community, women in real estate development,
community development training, underwriting a project budget.

## Ways in
- Free account: browse every course curriculum + one free live Lunch & Learn session
- Course passes: $100 (one course, 60 days) or $275 (all courses, 30 days) — written lessons
- Memberships from $49.99/mo — see Pricing above for the full structure
- Deep-dive series (e.g. The Underwriting Series) added over time
- Deal-specific support: the Owner membership, 1:1 sessions with Dr. Merritt,
  a $1,500 Full Project Intake (credited toward the retainer), and Senior
  Advisor retainers for whole-deal involvement
- Organizations (agencies, CDFIs, nonprofit developer programs) can sponsor a
  cohort's first year at a group discount with a branded partner page —
  see /partner-interest
